events.title: Kraków attack, day after: prosecutors investigate the Saturday shooting (six dead on the Main Market Square, 15 injured) as terrorism; square reopened in the evening; deputy PM Gawkowski warns of a wave of disinformation
events.note: Nowhere in the planning file (prepared 6 Nov, before the attack). Not announced in advance; no sweep gap. Already a missed event in the 2026-11-08 file; the follow-ups (mourning to 11 Nov, charges, Independence Day security on 11 Nov) remain candidates for the next editions.

events.title: Israel: Herzog formally tasks Gadi Eisenkot with forming the government; 28 days, extendable by 14
lists: reuters (as cited in the ct24 piece; Reuters page not read)
events.note: Lead story. Not on the Wikipedia day page as read.

events.title: Russian attacks on Ukraine: drone strike on rescuers at Komyshuvakha, one dead in Odesa and one near Dnipro, over half a million without power in Dnipropetrovsk region
events.note: The edition covers the same day's attacks through the Air Force overnight drone count ahead of Abu Dhabi; it does not mention the deaths, the attack on rescuers or the power cuts.

events.title: US-Iran: explosions on Qeshm after US fire; Trump tells CNN that renewed attacks on Iran are very unlikely
events.note: Loose pairing: Wikipedia has the Qeshm explosions (Middle East Eye), ctk has Trump's CNN remark; both are the weekend US-Iran step the story covers. Trump's 'very unlikely' line sits against the story's 'US forces strike Iran again'; that is for the resolver.

events.title: Czech public media: Babiš and Havlíček refuse the five opposition leaders' call for a separate debate on ČT/ČRo funding; coalition council on Monday
events.note: The story's event is the opposition's withdrawal call in Nedělní debata; the lists lead with Babiš's refusal. Same dispute, same day.

events.title: Nedělní debata: Havlíček to present the government a plan for further energy price rises (caps on end prices via the regulated component) on Monday; SPD's Fiala says the coalition may discuss extending the sector tax beyond refineries
events.note: Partly covered: cz-sector-tax covers the sector-tax half (banks left open, Havlíček in the debate). The energy price-cap plan itself was not in the planning file or the edition; it was announced on the day, not in advance. Fiala's remark on extending the tax is for the resolver against the bank-levy claim.

events.title: Kantar October voter model for ČT: ANO 29.5 %, STAN 23.5 %, five parties above the threshold
events.note: Planning dropped list, 'Czech voter model on Sunday (Kantar for ČT, STEM, Median)': 'No release announced; Kantar's last model for ČT was on 30 Aug.' The model did come out on Sunday. ČT airs the Kantar model in its Sunday programming, so a Sunday release was foreseeable; whether ČT announced it in advance was not verified. Worth a look at the ČT programme/press pages in the sweep.
